narratives.Overview:
## Summary

**#1423 Wave 2 only** — productize **bootstrap mass-triage** on top of shipped Wave 1 (`triage:classify -- --mirror` / `--apply`, #3118).

Wave 1 already walks the github-issue cache and plans/applies labels. Wave 2 makes that a **safe brownfield job**: filters, operator digest, batched apply. It does **not** implement Wave 3 agent comments or #3124 discovery.

## Parent

- **#1423** — SCM auto-triage write-back RFC (Wave 1 done; this issue = Wave 2; Wave 3 remains on parent)
- **#886** — triage mega-review umbrella (Wave C in current-shape)

## Context (dogfood)

| Repo | Scanned | Planned | Lesson |
|------|--------:|--------:|--------|
| statusreport | 22 | 2 | Open backlog mostly `no_match` without consumer rules |
| **directive** | **1113** | **686** | ~580 planned were **closed** (`closed-never-triaged`); ~106 open useful hits |

Blind `--apply` on full cache would mass-label closed history. Wave 2 must default to a **controlled blast radius**.

## In scope

### 1. Bootstrap entrypoint
Clear mass-job surface (extend `triage:classify -- --mirror` with bootstrap flags **or** dedicated `triage:bootstrap-classify` / equivalent). Document in commands.md.

### 2. Filters
- **State filter** with safe default (recommend **open-only**; opt-in `--include-closed` or equivalent)
- Honor existing already-`triaged` skip
- `--repo` as today
- Document filter matrix

### 3. Digest (dry-run default)
Operator-readable summary **before** any write:
- Totals: scanned / planned / no_match / already_triaged / errors
- Breakdown: by **state** (open/closed), by **rule**, by **action**
- Sample issue list (not only a 600-line dump as the primary UX)
- `--json` for scripts

### 4. Safe apply
- Dry-run default; explicit `--apply`
- Batched SCM writes + rate-limit awareness
- Idempotent re-run
- Partial failure reporting
- Clear behavior if `triaged` (or actionLabels) missing on the repo
- **Never** `triage:accept` / **never** write `proposed/` xBRIEFs

### 5. Tests + CHANGELOG
Unit/integration for filters, digest shape, batch apply mocks; CHANGELOG [Unreleased].

## Out of scope

- Wave 3 agent-authored triage comments
- #3124 operator discovery / ritual tip (starts **after** this ships)
- Redesign of classify match DSL
- Auto-accept into lifecycle
- Requiring full #1789 area:* rollout (compose if present)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Documented bootstrap/mass entrypoint on top of Wave 1 mirror
- [ ] Default filter avoids mass-labeling all closed history (open-only or equally safe default)
- [ ] Dry-run digest shows totals + breakdown by state/rule/action (+ JSON)
- [ ] `--apply` batches writes, is rate-limit aware, idempotent, reports partial failures
- [ ] Still never calls `triage:accept` / never writes `proposed/`
- [ ] Tests cover filter default, digest fields, apply batching/idempotency
- [ ] CHANGELOG [Unreleased] for this Wave 2 issue / #1423 Wave 2
- [ ] Dogfood note: dry-run on deftai/directive with open-only shows sensible planned counts (no requirement to apply)

## Implementation sketch

Compose: `packages/core/src/triage/classify/label-mirror.ts`, CLI `triage-classify`, help/registry, commands.md. Prefer extending mirror options over a second write path.

## Depends on

- #1423 Wave 1 / #3118 (done)

## Unblocks

- #3124 (operator discovery — after this)
- Safer path to Wave 3 on #1423
narratives.UserStory: As a brownfield operator, I want a dry-run mass-triage bootstrap with open-only default and a clear digest, so that I can apply triaged labels safely without mass-stamping closed history.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Extend packages/core/src/triage/classify/label-mirror.ts with filter options (state open-only default, include-closed opt-in) and digest aggregates (by state, rule, action) plus sample list. Step 2: Wire CLI packages/cli/src/triage-classify.ts flags for bootstrap/mass mode, filters, dry-run default, apply batching and rate-limit delays. Step 3: Human + JSON digest output; keep never-accept invariant. Step 4: Tests for filter default, digest fields, batch apply idempotency mocks in label-mirror.test.ts and triage-classify tests. Step 5: content/commands.md + triage help registry + CHANGELOG Unreleased for #3125 / #1423 Wave 2. Verification: vitest classify/label-mirror + CLI tests; dry-run on deftai/directive with open-only yields planned roughly on order of open hits not full closed archive.
